response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and embedded work, plus some genuine high-throughput distributed systems exposure at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby and open-source platform ownership. However, the role's hard requirement of 8 years of C++ is not close to being met — documented C/C++ work amounts to roughly seven months at National Instruments plus a university thesis project, with the bulk of the career in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. There is also no evidence of formal technical leadership of a cloud compute platform, large-scale infrastructure ownership, or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers at the scale described. The profile reads as a strong senior full-stack/product engineer rather than a systems-level technical lead for an internal compute platform.
strengths: Low-latency, high-throughput microservices experience (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic)
Founded and operates an open-source, Kubernetes-deployable platform end to end
Strong mentoring signal: workshops, courses, conference talks, dev tooling and CI/CD ownership
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~1 year, over a decade ago)
No demonstrated cloud compute platform or large-scale infrastructure leadership role
Career trajectory is product/full-stack web rather than systems and hardware architecture

key_factors.factor: Distributed systems and performance engineering exposure
